plugins.name: GitHub notifications
plugins.description: Pushes your GitHub notifications (review requests, mentions, assignments, CI results) to all your devices.
plugins.author: Ferry

plugins.name: Hacker News top stories
plugins.description: Pushes Hacker News front-page stories once they pass a score you choose.
plugins.author: Ferry

plugins.name: Page watch
plugins.description: Watches web pages you list and pushes a link when their text changes, or when they start to contain a phrase you choose.
plugins.author: Ferry

plugins.name: RSS and Atom feeds
plugins.description: Follows the RSS and Atom feeds (or sites) you list and pushes each new post as a link.
plugins.author: Ferry

plugins.name: Wishlist sales for Steam
plugins.description: Pushes when games on your public Steam wishlist go on sale at or above the discount you choose. Unofficial; not made by or affiliated with Valve.
plugins.author: Ferry

plugins.name: Uptime check
plugins.description: Checks your websites every few minutes and pushes to all your devices when one goes down or comes back.
plugins.author: Ferry

plugins.name: US severe weather alerts
plugins.description: Pushes official National Weather Service alerts for your US location or state, using the free weather.gov API.
plugins.author: Ferry
